newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end higher, near peaks.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end higher, near peaks.

text.p: Sept 9 - U.S. stock index futures ended higher, with Sept S&P 500s closing with big gains and near day's peaks. Traders said afternoon strength stemmed from resilience in T-bond futures, which snapped back from morning losses. Gains in OTC, key blue-chip stocks, plus technical buying and followthrough from Friday's rally, gave support. Some saw early arb buy programs. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
